openings.claim: Join surname divider cards' region narrowing with the daily paper exception slip's temporary-location recording at a named divider-range/exception-row interface. A divider range selects its slip band; a matching current exception routes the clerk directly to the cart or other recorded location before searching shelves. This proposes coupled routing, not a demonstrated benefit.
openings.delta: Keep all records behind the desk. Mark slip bands with existing divider ranges and update the same slip whenever the clerk moves an exceptional hold. Retain clerk-only handoffs and existing furniture. Recipient verification remains necessary because region routing cannot resolve household ownership by itself.
openings.prediction: With accurate entries, exceptional pickups avoid the failed shelf search followed by another location; intact coupling should outperform separately usable cards and slip on these pickups. Whether 95% finish within two minutes with zero wrong-reader handoffs remains unproven.
openings.rival_prediction: The nearest alternative is simply keeping the uncoupled slip current. If stale entries dominate delays, that repair should perform comparably even without divider-range coupling.
openings.defeat: Comparable pickup times after breaking only the range-to-row link, persistent second-location searches despite correct links, any wrong-reader handoff, or preparation plus location corrections exceeding ten clerk-minutes defeats the proposal's claimed advantage or fit.
openings.probe: Use existing paper and timing sheet for a capped behind-desk scripted rehearsal with matched arrivals, household mismatches, moves and peak workload. Compare four configurations and a scrambled-link hybrid while retaining accurate entries. Stop preparation and corrections at ten minutes; report incompletion. This bounded probe can fit; successful evening intervention remains unverified.
assumptions: Accurate book-to-recipient information and a clerk verification procedure are available; neither is verified by the fixture.
Range marking and every movement update can fit the total preparation budget.
Scripted rehearsal predicts actual evening performance only provisionally.

component_comparison.baseline: Incumbent uncoupled cards and preopening slip: predict stale-location and second-search exposure.
component_comparison.parent_a: Divider cards alone: predict narrower shelf searches but no temporary-location route.
component_comparison.parent_b: Daily exception slip alone: predict temporary-location information but no divider-selected lookup.
component_comparison.hybrid: Under identical requirements, predict divider-selected current exception routing avoids unnecessary shelf searches.
component_comparison.interaction_test: Compare intact versus scrambled range links with identical accurate slip contents and divider regions; loss of advantage supports an interaction beyond separate benefits. Also compare the uncoupled current-slip rival.
